## About

Vikas Saxena is a passionate Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications. He works across the full stack using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), TypeScript, Next.js, and modern UI frameworks. He is actively exploring AI integration, intelligent agents, and automation workflows.

  Led development of production websites, built scalable React architecture, integrated REST APIs, implemented SEO and Lighthouse optimisations.

- **Frontend Developer** – Tattva Technologies (Jan 2025 – Mar 2025, Full-time, Remote)
  Built responsive UIs with React.js and Tailwind CSS, developed reusable components, ensured cross-browser compatibility.

- **Software Intern** – Mobzway Technologies (Sep 2024 – Dec 2024, Remote)
  Built an AI chatbot using Google Gemini Flash API, developed real-time features with Socket.io, worked with MongoDB.
